events.continuity_hook: Continues the Hampton Roads assessment after the possible extra night becomes required.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the safer airport plan, confirm the added night, and narrow the hotel location based on the Wednesday 6:30 a.m. plant access and Thursday session timing.
events.scenario_brief: The Hampton Roads client confirms a Thursday morning operator session after the Wednesday plant walk, so Jonah now needs three hotel nights and a return that does not force him out before the second session ends. He wants to keep the Monday arrival reliable, compare the cleaner Norfolk routing against a Richmond option with a longer drive, and narrow hotels between a Chesapeake property closer to the plant and a better-dining Norfolk option farther from the early access point.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Hampton Roads utility assessment from comparison to booking once the Thursday timing is pinned down.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, hotel, three-night stay, room notes, seat request, and concise calendar itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The client says the Thursday operator session should finish before lunch, making a Thursday afternoon return workable. Jonah settles on a Monday Bay Area departure into Norfolk with one manageable connection, a Thursday afternoon return, and the Chesapeake-area hotel because it keeps the early plant drive short while still leaving practical dinner options nearby. He wants the room request to include a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and he wants a window seat if seat selection is open.

events.continuity_hook: Adds a practical site-access and arrival check to the already booked Hampton Roads trip.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the hotel arrival note, verify the seat detail, and update the itinerary with the plant gate, visitor lot, and safety briefing time.
events.scenario_brief: The plant safety coordinator sends updated visitor instructions with a different gate, a required safety briefing time, and a note that rental cars must use a specific visitor lot. Jonah does not want to reopen the trip search; he needs the itinerary notes updated, the hotel late-arrival note checked because of the evening Norfolk arrival, and the outbound seat assignment verified.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a personal weekend episode after the Hampton Roads utility trip logistics are wrapped up.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight-and-hotel shortlist for two travelers that balances airport convenience, weekend timing, hotel quality, pool access, and walkable dining.
events.scenario_brief: After several work trips, Jonah and his spouse start planning a relaxed Palm Springs long weekend. They want to compare Bay Area flights into Palm Springs against using Ontario with a drive if schedules or fares are much better, and they are looking at hotels near downtown or Uptown with strong guest feedback, a pool, and walkable restaurants. The open items are whether to rent a car for the whole weekend and how much extra the closer Palm Springs airport is worth.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Palm Springs weekend after the spouse’s timing window narrows the flight choices.
events.interaction_goal: Pick the more practical airport plan, compare the two hotel styles, and decide whether to include a rental car.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah’s spouse can leave Friday after lunch but wants to be home by Sunday evening, so the trip shifts away from any very early outbound or late return. The flight choice is between a pricier SFO nonstop into Palm Springs and a cheaper Ontario option that adds a drive, while the hotel choice is down to a downtown boutique property with easier restaurants versus a resort-style option farther out with a better pool. They also need to decide whether a weekend rental car is useful or just an added hassle.

events.continuity_hook: Completes the Palm Springs weekend plan after the airport, hotel, and rental-car decisions are made.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the two-person flight booking, hotel reservation, seating arrangement, cancellation note, and a clean weekend itinerary summary.
events.scenario_brief: They decide the nonstop into Palm Springs is worth the premium for a short weekend and choose the downtown boutique hotel because it avoids needing a car for most meals. The selected plan is a Friday afternoon Bay Area departure, a Sunday afternoon return, a cancellable king room, and no rental car unless they later add a day trip. Seat selection should prioritize sitting together rather than Jonah’s usual solo work-trip seat choice.
